attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Hardcoded element IDs (#color, #color_wrapper, #color_opacity) will collide when multiple ColorField instances appear on the same edit form (e.g. bags/lists or multiple fields), breaking the picker for all but one instance, and the new alpha-appended hex value (#rrggbbaa) changes the stored text format which downstream themes/validators expecting standard 6-digit hex colors may not handle."}

reason: Hardcoded element IDs (#color, #color_wrapper, #color_opacity) will collide when multiple ColorField instances appear on the same edit form (e.g. bags/lists or multiple fields), breaking the picker for all but one instance, and the new alpha-appended hex value (#rrggbbaa) changes the stored text format which downstream themes/validators expecting standard 6-digit hex colors may not handle.
